title: Karaoke Club 01 — 1990s basement
purpose: Transparent central illustration for a red Machi Koro-style Karaoke Club card variant.
generation_prompt: Мультяшная миниатюра российского караоке в подвале 1990-х: лестница вниз, ЭЛТ-телевизор, проводные микрофоны, спутанные кабели, поющие скуфы, диско-шар. Стиль настольной игры, чистые контуры, плоские цвета, вид три четверти. Светлый белый фон, без текста.
research_basis: Specialized Russian karaoke venues appeared in the mid-1990s, including basement locations.
Early systems used laser discs, wired microphones, CRT displays, and small song selections.

integration_context.target_use: Generate only the central illustration; it will be composited onto the existing red card template.
integration_context.background_requirement: Native RGBA transparency with alpha=0 outside the miniature and its integral base; no checkerboard, sky, scenery, glow, card furniture, or backdrop.
integration_context.text_policy: Absolute no-text rule: no letters, numbers, words, song codes, labels, signage, logos, screen lyrics, graffiti, or pseudo-writing anywhere. Use only a microphone pictogram above the entrance.
integration_context.orientation: Front facade faces slightly right, the building's left side is visible, and depth recedes toward image left.

style_goal.core: Same polished cartoon board-game language as the approved Karaoke Club card: chunky toy-like forms, rounded expressive adult caricatures, crisp dark outlines, clean flat colors, simple cel shading, low-to-moderate detail.
style_goal.palette: Cold concrete gray, faded burgundy, nicotine beige, dim amber, electric violet and cyan accents.

content.subject: A shabby late-1990s karaoke club in the basement of a provincial apartment block.
content.description: A compact cutaway-like building miniature showing a worn concrete ground floor and a below-grade basement entrance reached by steep steps under a rusty canopy. Narrow basement windows and an open stairwell reveal a cramped low-ceilinged karaoke room: patterned wallpaper, plastic chairs, cheap tables, one bulky CRT television, a large disc player, several long wired microphones, mismatched speakers, and a tiny mirrored disco ball. A stocky tracksuit-clad man sings with eyes closed while two friends solemnly join in; another squats under the table untangling an absurd nest of microphone cables; a patient woman holds a thick song catalogue with completely blank pages. The visual joke is early karaoke technology barely functioning but everyone singing with full conviction.
recognition_details: below-grade entrance and small basement windows
bulky CRT television with abstract colored bars only
wired microphones and comic cable tangle
content.miniature_base: A compact cracked-concrete slab with basement steps and a short metal railing, isolated on transparency.
